name: bone_v4
subject: three copies of the same cartoon dog bone treat, the shiny collectible of a cute 1990s SNES platformer, lying exactly horizontal: a short thick shaft between two pairs of round ball-shaped knobs; strongly three-dimensional, lit from the upper left: each knob a shaded sphere with a small bright white specular highlight on its upper left, the shaft a shaded cylinder with a light band along its top and a darker band underneath, a warm reflected light on the undersides; creamy ivory to warm caramel, one dark brown 1 px outline all round
part_map: each grey bone shape is one bone: the round lumps at the two ends are the knobs, the bar between them the shaft. Draw all three, the same design at the three sizes.
size_sentence: the bones are about a third of the dog's length; big tasty treats next to the dog.
